products.title: Wallpaper - Murgese Horses
products.description_html:
Wallpaper is made to order and gets customized based on the size of your wall. 
Horses symbolise power, agility and freedom. This wallpaper, adorned with a pattern of horses in different colours and shades, does not instantly reveal the subject, but only after a second glance outlines the silhouettes of the steeds which bring the wall to life with their elegant and forceful poses. Eye-catching use of on-trend colours and sinuous lines.

products.description_html:
Stucco makes a playful reference to the decorative plaster used during Greco-Roman antiquity. It is an abstraction of textile and the tone-on-tone colour palette ensures a serene but weathered look.

This wallpaper is sold by the linear metre and can therefore not be cancelled or returned.

products.title: Wallpaper - Refined Structures 2 - Brera
tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
Brera, “the district of the artists”, is the most renowned of Milan: located in the heart of the historic city center, it is famous for its charming atmosphere and fine boutiques. The same elegance defines this new wallcovering, inspired by the details of the Armani Privé collections. The design created by the embroidering of thousands of beads is reproduced on the vinyl support, made precious by the use of a pearlescent finishing that highlights the three-dimensional effect. Presented in neutral tones as well as pastel blue and green.

Length 10,050 mt - 32,964 ft
Quality Vinilico
Composition Heavy weight vinyl
